title: List of Berserker dialogue
html:
Spoiler warning: The following content contains unhidden spoilers. Read at your own risk.
This page is in the process of being constructed or reformatted. You are welcome to contribute as well.
Last edited on 2025-08-05. If multiple days have passed since, this template should be removed.

Below is a list of all Berserker-tagged dialogue, sorted by roll, then DC (if it has one).

Note: This is far from a comprehensive list. It is closer to a list of tagged dialogue located on various pages on the wiki.

  • [BERSERKER] FILTHY BUGS! LEAVE! (DC 10 )
  • [BERSERKER] Give in. KILL THE MAGGOT.
  • [BERSERKER] ROAR AT THE NECROMANCER.
  • [BERSERKER] ROAR.
  • [BERSERKER] Make me submit. SHOW ME YOUR RAGE.
  • [BERSERKER] YES.
  • [BERSERKER] WE WILL DECIDE IN BLOOD. YOU FIGHT WELL, YOU LIVE.
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 20 )
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 20 )
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] FOLLOW ME AGAIN AND I'LL EAT YOU. (DC 20 )

  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] JOIN ME OR I'LL CRUSH YOU TO PULP! (DC 20 )
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] YOUR LIFE. GIVE IT. (DC 20 )
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] THEN LOWER THE PRICE. OR DIE. (DC 20 )
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAR. (DC 18)
